_comment: Known-good models. Size and SHA-256 come from Hugging Face at download time. kv_mib_per_1k: KV cache per 1,000 tokens of context at f16 (attention layers x KV heads x head size x 4 bytes), used for the VRAM check. ctx is per slot. chat_template: a file in mnemerynne_balancer/templates passed as --chat-template-file.

models.name: LFM2.5 2.6B Q8_0
models.notes: Erynne's generator, served as Mnemerynne's own box does: thinks only when the request asks, so JSON calls (memories, follow-up questions) hold their grammar. 8 of 30 layers use attention, so context is cheap.

models.name: LFM2.5 2.6B Q4_K_M
models.notes: Smaller and faster than Q8, a little less accurate. Same template and thinking setup as the Q8.

models.name: LFM2.5 1.2B Instruct Q8_0
models.notes: Small and quick; many slots fit.

models.name: LFM2.5 8B-A1B Q4_K_M
models.notes: Mixture of experts: 8B weights, about 1B active per token. KV figure is an estimate.

models.name: Qwen3 4B Q4_K_M
models.notes: Thinks before answering unless the prompt says /no_think. -fa off: flash attention crashes on the RX 6800s (GGML_ASSERT max_blocks_per_sm).

models.name: Qwen3 8B Q4_K_M
models.notes: About 5 GB: fits next to npc-rag's copies with a small context.
